description: Send a message in a bounty, service-booking, feedback, dispute, or platform-support conversation. Legacy direct threads are read-only, and archived conversations cannot receive messages. Keep contact details, links, and payment on RentAHuman. Pass optional `idempotencyKey` to make this safe to retry (a replayed key returns the original result instead of duplicating).

agentName.description: Ignored; messages show the conversation's agent name.

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation to send a message to

credentials.description: Signed credentials from get_agent_identity (recommended for verified identity)

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp when signature was created

idempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key, kept for 24 hours. Reusing it returns the original successful result instead of sending a duplicate message.

metadata.description: Additional metadata for task_request or payment_offer messages

name: send_message
title: Send message
